Select distinct molecule chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles for all molecules mentioned in document CHEMBL1123860. Join docs filtered by chembl_id CHEMBL1123860 to compound_records, then to molecule_dictionary and compound_structures. Require canonical_smiles to be present. Return chembl_id, compound_name, canonical_smiles. Sort by chembl_id, compound_name, canonical_smiles.
